name: Tesla Violet
original_name: テスラ・ヴァイオレット
source:
A girl transferred to St. Cherine's School as an exchange student alongside her twin sister, Nine. Her true identity is the 'Twin Phantom' for the secret organization Black Fund. After battling the Twin Angels numerous times, they eventually reconciled and became allies. 

After her transformation, she specializes in long-range attacks using lightning strikes.

[Translated from the [url=https://twin-angel-psp.com/character4.html]official site[/url]]
